exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Arch lower back slightly, retract scapulae, lower bar under control to mid-chest, drive up explosively.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Set bench at 30 degrees. Keep elbows at 45 degrees, deep stretch at bottom and squeeze at peak.

exercises.name: Chest Fly
exercises.instructions: Slight bend in elbows. Bring arms together in a hugging motion, squeeze pecs hard at center.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.instructions: Lie perpendicular across bench. Lower dumbbell behind head with deep ribcage stretch, pull over to chest.

exercises.name: Push Ups
exercises.instructions: Maintain strong core plank. Lower chest to floor and push up with full range of motion.

days.focus: 3D Deltoid Mass, Overhead Power & Traps

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Brace glutes and abs, press bar in straight vertical path clearing chin, lock out overhead.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Lead with elbows, slight forward lean, pause at parallel for maximum delt tension.

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.instructions: Raise dumbbells to eye level with controlled tempo. Avoid swinging torso.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward at 45 degrees or use incline bench. Pull arms wide to isolate rear delts.

exercises.name: Shrugs
exercises.instructions: Elevate shoulders straight up towards ears, squeeze traps for 1 second, lower under control.

days.focus: Arm Thickness, Peak Hypertrophy & Forearms

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Keep elbows pinned to ribs. Curl barbell upward with strong contraction and controlled 3-second eccentric.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Supinate wrists as you curl upward to maximize bicep contraction at peak.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Palms facing each other throughout. Great for arm thickness and grip strength.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: Rest upper arms firmly against angled pad to eliminate momentum and isolate the bicep peak.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit and brace elbow against inner thigh. Curl dumbbell smoothly with intense focus.

days.focus: Tricep Horseshoe, Lockout Power & Density

exercises.name: Close Grip Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Grip shoulder-width apart. Keep elbows tucked close to body while pressing to overload triceps.

exercises.name: Rope Push Down
exercises.instructions: Spread rope apart at bottom of motion. Lock out triceps hard for 1 second.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Ext.
exercises.instructions: Keep elbows high and stationary. Lower weight behind head for a deep long head stretch.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.instructions: Stay upright on parallel bars to emphasize triceps. Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Kick Back
exercises.instructions: Torso parallel to floor, upper arm parallel to torso. Extend forearm back and squeeze.

exercises.name: Pull Ups
exercises.instructions: Dead hang at bottom, drive elbows down to ribs, pull chest up toward bar.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge at 45 degrees, pull bar towards belly button, pinch shoulder blades together tightly.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull bar smoothly down to upper chest while leaning back slightly. Control the ascent.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sit upright with neutral spine. Pull attachment into lower abdomen and squeeze back.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Bar over midfoot, chest proud, brace core, drive through heels to full standing lockout.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width, brace abdominal wall, descend below parallel, drive up through midfoot.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Position feet mid-platform. Lower sled with control without lifting pelvis, press without knee lockout.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Extend legs fully, hold peak contraction at top for 1 full second, lower with 3-second negative.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Lie flat on machine pad. Curl heels up toward glutes with strong hamstring squeeze.

exercises.instructions: Full stretch at bottom, explode up onto toes and hold at top for 2 seconds.

exercises.name: Leg Press

exercises.name: Calf Raise

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie flat on bench with eyes under barbell. Grip slightly wider than shoulder width, arch lower back slightly, and retract scapulae.
exercises.technique: Lower bar in a controlled 3-second descent touching lower sternum. Drive upward explosively without flaring elbows.
exercises.breathing: Inhale deeply at the top and hold during descent; exhale forcefully past the sticking point.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Set bench to 30 degrees. Kick dumbbells up to shoulder level with knees, plant feet firmly, and press up over upper chest.
exercises.technique: Keep elbows at 45 degrees to torso. Lower until you feel a deep stretch in upper pecs, then drive inward.
exercises.breathing: Inhale on the lowering phase; exhale as you push the dumbbells upward.
commonMistakes: Setting bench angle too high (>45°) which shifts load to shoulders
Touching dumbbells together at top and losing tension

exercises.name: Chest Fly
exercises.instructions: Lie supine holding dumbbells above chest with neutral grip and slight bend in elbows.
exercises.technique: Open arms in a wide hugging arc until chest is stretched. Squeeze pecs hard to bring dumbbells back together.
exercises.breathing: Inhale as you open wide into the chest stretch; exhale as you adduct arms back to center.
commonMistakes: Bending elbows too much and turning it into a press
Going too heavy and hyperextending shoulders

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.instructions: Rest upper back perpendicular across a flat bench, hips slightly lowered. Hold one dumbbell with both hands in diamond grip.
exercises.technique: Lower dumbbell behind head in an arc until a deep ribcage stretch is achieved. Pull back over chest focusing on serratus and pecs.
exercises.breathing: Take a deep diaphragmatic breath expanding the ribcage as the weight lowers; exhale as you pull over.
commonMistakes: Bending elbows excessively like a triceps extension
Allowing hips to rise up above bench height

exercises.name: Push-Ups
exercises.instructions: Place hands shoulder-width apart on floor, feet together, body in rigid plank.
exercises.technique: Lower chest to 1 inch off the floor with elbows tracking 45 degrees back. Press up to full arm extension.
exercises.breathing: Inhale descending; exhale driving up while bracing core.
commonMistakes: Sagging lower back or piking hips in the air
Half reps without full chest depth

days.focus: 3D Deltoid Mass, Overhead Power & Upper Trapezius

days.cooldown: Cross-body shoulder stretch & gentle neck lateral stretches.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width, bar resting across clavicles. Squeeze glutes and brace core.
exercises.technique: Press bar vertically, tilting head slightly back to clear chin, then pushing head through window at top lockout.
exercises.breathing: Inhale and brace core before pressing; exhale once past forehead level.
commonMistakes: Pressing bar forward instead of vertical

exercises.name: Lateral Raise

exercises.breathing: Exhale as you raise outward; inhale on controlled descent.
commonMistakes: Shrugging traps instead of isolating lateral delts

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand upright holding dumbbells in front of thighs with overhand grip.
exercises.technique: Raise dumbbells straight forward to eye level with strict control. Pause for a split second, then lower slowly.
exercises.breathing: Exhale on upward lift; inhale lowering down.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: Hinge at hips to a 45-degree angle with flat spine and soft knees. Let dumbbells hang below shoulders.
exercises.technique: Sweep arms out wide and slightly back like wings, squeezing the back of your shoulders at the peak.
exercises.breathing: Exhale raising wide; inhale returning under control.
commonMistakes: Using heavy weights and turning it into a row

exercises.name: Shrugs
exercises.instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides with neutral grip, arms straight and shoulders back.
exercises.technique: Elevate shoulders straight upward towards your ears. Hold the peak contraction for 1-2 seconds, then lower under control.
exercises.breathing: Exhale on shrug elevation; inhale on the eccentric stretch.
commonMistakes: Rolling shoulders in circles (injures rotator cuffs)

exercises.breathing: Exhale curling upward; inhale lowering down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl

exercises.breathing: Exhale as you curl and supinate; inhale during descent.

exercises.breathing: Exhale curling bar up; inhale as you lower smoothly.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit on bench with legs spread. Brace back of elbow against inner thigh of same side.
exercises.technique: Curl dumbbell up smoothly towards your face, keeping torso steady. Peak squeeze at top for 1 second.
exercises.breathing: Exhale curling; inhale lowering.
commonMistakes: Moving elbow along thigh during repetition

exercises.breathing: Inhale lowering hips; exhale pressing up.
commonMistakes: Leaning too far forward (shifts load to chest)

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback

exercises.technique: Extend forearm straight back into full elbow lockout, squeezing tricep hard before returning to 90 degrees.
exercises.breathing: Exhale extending back; inhale returning forward.

exercises.name: Barbell Row

exercises.technique: Pull bar towards your navel, driving elbows back and pinching shoulder blades together tightly.
exercises.breathing: Exhale rowing upward; inhale lowering bar under control.
commonMistakes: Standing too upright and turning it into a shrug

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.equipment: Cable Lat Machine & Wide Curved Bar
exercises.instructions: Lock thighs firmly under pads. Grip wide curved bar with overhand grip, slight lean back.
exercises.technique: Pull bar down smoothly to upper collarbone while expanding chest. Slowly control ascent back up.
exercises.breathing: Exhale pulling down; inhale returning bar overhead.
commonMistakes: Pulling bar behind the neck (dangerous for rotator cuffs)

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.equipment: Low Pulley Cable Row & V-Grip Handle
exercises.instructions: Sit upright with feet braced against footplates and knees softly bent. Grasp V-grip handle.
exercises.technique: Pull handle into lower abdomen while keeping spine tall. Squeeze back muscles for 1 second.
exercises.breathing: Exhale pulling into ribs; inhale extending arms forward.
commonMistakes: Leaning back excessively to jerk weight

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.targetMuscle: Entire Posterior Chain, Erector Spinae & Glutes
exercises.instructions: Bar over midfoot, feet hip-width. Hinge down and take double-overhand or mixed grip. Pull chest proud and lock lats.
exercises.technique: Push the floor away through midfoot, keeping bar glued to shins and thighs until hips lock out tall.
exercises.breathing: Deep diaphragmatic breath and brace at bottom; exhale through lockout.
commonMistakes: Squatting the bar instead of hinging

exercises.name: Leg Press

exercises.name: Leg Extension

exercises.name: Calf Raise

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie flat on bench with eyes under barbell. Grip slightly wider than shoulder width, arch lower back slightly, and retract scapulae.
exercises.technique: Lower bar in a controlled 3-second descent touching lower sternum. Drive upward explosively without flaring elbows.
exercises.breathing: Inhale deeply at the top and hold during descent; exhale forcefully past the sticking point.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Set bench to 30 degrees. Kick dumbbells up to shoulder level with knees, plant feet firmly, and press up over upper chest.
exercises.technique: Keep elbows at 45 degrees to torso. Lower until you feel a deep stretch in upper pecs, then drive inward.
exercises.breathing: Inhale on the lowering phase; exhale as you push the dumbbells upward.
commonMistakes: Setting bench angle too high (>45°) which shifts load to shoulders
Touching dumbbells together at top and losing tension

exercises.name: Chest Fly
exercises.instructions: Lie supine holding dumbbells above chest with neutral grip and slight bend in elbows.
exercises.technique: Open arms in a wide hugging arc until chest is stretched. Squeeze pecs hard to bring dumbbells back together.
exercises.breathing: Inhale as you open wide into the chest stretch; exhale as you adduct arms back to center.
commonMistakes: Bending elbows too much and turning it into a press
Going too heavy and hyperextending shoulders

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.instructions: Rest upper back perpendicular across a flat bench, hips slightly lowered. Hold one dumbbell with both hands in diamond grip.
exercises.technique: Lower dumbbell behind head in an arc until a deep ribcage stretch is achieved. Pull back over chest focusing on serratus and pecs.
exercises.breathing: Take a deep diaphragmatic breath expanding the ribcage as the weight lowers; exhale as you pull over.
commonMistakes: Bending elbows excessively like a triceps extension
Allowing hips to rise up above bench height

exercises.name: Push-Ups
exercises.instructions: Place hands shoulder-width apart on floor, feet together, body in rigid plank.
exercises.technique: Lower chest to 1 inch off the floor with elbows tracking 45 degrees back. Press up to full arm extension.
exercises.breathing: Inhale descending; exhale driving up while bracing core.
commonMistakes: Sagging lower back or piking hips in the air
Half reps without full chest depth

days.cooldown: Cross-body shoulder stretch & gentle neck lateral stretches.

exercises.name: Overhead Press

exercises.technique: Press bar vertically, tilting head slightly back to clear chin, then pushing head through window at top lockout.
exercises.breathing: Inhale and brace core before pressing; exhale once past forehead level.
commonMistakes: Pressing bar forward instead of vertical

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with slight forward hinge, dumbbells at thighs with elbows slightly bent.
exercises.technique: Raise arms laterally leading with elbows until parallel to floor. Pour the pitcher slightly with thumbs angled down.
exercises.breathing: Exhale as you raise outward; inhale on controlled descent.
commonMistakes: Shrugging traps instead of isolating lateral delts

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand upright holding dumbbells in front of thighs with overhand grip.
exercises.technique: Raise dumbbells straight forward to eye level with strict control. Pause for a split second, then lower slowly.
exercises.breathing: Exhale on upward lift; inhale lowering down.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: Hinge at hips to a 45-degree angle with flat spine and soft knees. Let dumbbells hang below shoulders.
exercises.technique: Sweep arms out wide and slightly back like wings, squeezing the back of your shoulders at the peak.
exercises.breathing: Exhale raising wide; inhale returning under control.
commonMistakes: Using heavy weights and turning it into a row

exercises.name: Shrugs
exercises.instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides with neutral grip, arms straight and shoulders back.
exercises.technique: Elevate shoulders straight upward towards your ears. Hold the peak contraction for 1-2 seconds, then lower under control.
exercises.breathing: Exhale on shrug elevation; inhale on the eccentric stretch.
commonMistakes: Rolling shoulders in circles (injures rotator cuffs)

days.cooldown: Biceps wall stretch & forearm flexor/extensor stretches.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Stand tall holding barbell with shoulder-width supinated grip, elbows tucked against ribcage.
exercises.technique: Curl bar upward in a smooth arc to upper chest. Squeeze biceps hard at peak, then take 3 seconds to lower.
exercises.breathing: Exhale curling upward; inhale lowering down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides with palms facing each other at bottom position.
exercises.technique: Curl up while rotating wrist (supination) so palm faces ceiling by mid-repetition. Squeeze at top.
exercises.breathing: Exhale as you curl and supinate; inhale during descent.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other (neutral grip) throughout entire rep.
exercises.technique: Curl straight up toward shoulders maintaining neutral palms. Great for widening arm profile and forearms.
exercises.breathing: Exhale on contraction; inhale on descent.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit at preacher bench with upper arms flat against 45-degree pad, gripping inner EZ-bar knurling.
exercises.technique: Curl bar toward chin without lifting elbows off pad. Lower under strict control to 95% extension.
exercises.breathing: Exhale curling bar up; inhale as you lower smoothly.
commonMistakes: Hyperextending and locking out elbow violently at bottom

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit on bench with legs spread. Brace back of elbow against inner thigh of same side.
exercises.technique: Curl dumbbell up smoothly towards your face, keeping torso steady. Peak squeeze at top for 1 second.
exercises.breathing: Exhale curling; inhale lowering.
commonMistakes: Moving elbow along thigh during repetition

days.cooldown: Overhead triceps stretch & cross-body arm stretch.

exercises.name: Close Grip Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Grip barbell shoulder-width apart (approx 12-14 inches). Keep elbows tucked close to ribcage.
exercises.technique: Lower bar to lower ribcage under control, drive up forcefully locking out triceps.
exercises.breathing: Inhale lowering bar; exhale pressing up.

exercises.name: Rope Push Down

exercises.breathing: Exhale pushing down into lockout; inhale allowing rope to return to chest height.

Using body weight to press rope

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Sit upright gripping one dumbbell with both hands in diamond grip overhead.
exercises.technique: Lower dumbbell behind neck keeping elbows pointing upward. Extend arms back overhead to full lockout.
exercises.breathing: Inhale descending behind neck; exhale extending overhead.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.instructions: Mount parallel dip bars with arms straight and shoulders depressed down. Torso upright.
exercises.technique: Lower body by bending elbows until arms form 90 degrees. Press through palms to lock out.
exercises.breathing: Inhale lowering hips; exhale pressing up.
commonMistakes: Leaning too far forward (shifts load to chest)

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback
exercises.instructions: Hinge torso parallel to floor, pin upper arm alongside ribcage, holding dumbbell.
exercises.technique: Extend forearm straight back into full elbow lockout, squeezing tricep hard before returning to 90 degrees.
exercises.breathing: Exhale extending back; inhale returning forward.
